sections.quote: All applications, regardless of the amount of direct costs requested for any one year, must address a Data Management and Sharing Plan.

eligibility.item: Eligible organizations: domestic higher education institutions; nonprofits; for-profit organizations including small businesses; state, county, city/township, special district and tribal governments; U.S. territories; independent school districts; public/Indian housing authorities; tribal organizations; faith- or community-based organizations; and regional organizations
eligibility.quote: Higher Education Institutions Public/State Controlled Institutions of Higher Education Private Institutions of Higher Education

eligibility.item: Non-domestic (foreign) entities and non-domestic components of U.S. organizations are not eligible; foreign components are allowed
eligibility.quote: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) Entities (Foreign Organizations) are not eligible to apply. Non-domestic (non-U.S.) components of U.S. Organizations are not eligible to apply.

eligibility.item: A single candidate PD/PI works with their mentor and organization; multiple PDs/PIs are not allowed
eligibility.quote: Any candidate with the skills, knowledge, and resources necessary to carry out the proposed research as the Program Director/Principal Investigator (PD/PI) is invited to work with their mentor and organization to develop an application for support. Multiple PDs/PIs are not allowed.

eligibility.item: By the time of award, the candidate must be a U.S. citizen, non-citizen national, or lawful permanent resident
eligibility.quote: By the time of award, the individual must be a citizen or a non-citizen national of the United States or have been lawfully admitted for permanent residence

eligibility.item: Candidate must have a research or health-professional doctoral degree
eligibility.quote: Candidates for the K18 award must have a research or health-professional doctoral degree.

eligibility.item: Candidate must be a well-established investigator with a record of independent, peer-reviewed Federal or private research grant funding; active grant support at application is not required
eligibility.quote: This award is intended for well-established investigators who have established records of independent, peer-reviewed Federal or private research grant funding.

eligibility.item: Program focuses on established investigators at the rank of Associate Professor or Professor, or equivalent in non-academic research settings
eligibility.quote: It focuses on established investigators holding the academic rank of Associate Professor or Professor, or the equivalent in non-academic research settings,

eligibility.item: At the time of award, the candidate must have a full-time appointment at the applicant academic institution; VA effort may not count toward the full-time requirement
eligibility.quote: At the time of award, the candidate must have a "full-time" appointment at the academic institution that is the applicant organization.

eligibility.item: Candidate must devote at least 6 calendar months (50% of full-time professional effort) to the K18 program, up to 12 calendar months
eligibility.quote: The candidate is required to devote at least 6 calendar months (50% of full-time professional effort) to the K18 program, but may devote their full-time (12 calendar months) effort to it.

eligibility.item: The research experience generally spans a contiguous six months to two years; a six-month experience may be split over two successive full-time summer semesters
eligibility.quote: However, a six-month research experience may be apportioned over two successive summer semesters (of three months each), provided the experience is pursued on a full-time (100%) basis during these periods.

eligibility.item: Candidates with VA appointments should contact the relevant Institute or Center before preparing an application
eligibility.quote: Candidates with VA appointments should contact the staff person in the relevant Institute or Center prior to preparing an application to discuss their eligibility.

eligibility.item: Before submitting, the candidate must identify a mentor (active investigator in the area) who will supervise the career development and research experience
eligibility.quote: Before submitting the application, the candidate must identify a mentor who will supervise the proposed career development and research experience.

eligibility.item: Applicant institution must have a strong, well-established record of research and career development activities and qualified mentor faculty
eligibility.quote: The applicant institution must have a strong, well-established record of research and career development activities and faculty qualified to serve as mentors

eligibility.item: Applications must not propose leading a clinical trial; candidates may gain experience in a clinical trial led by a mentor/co-mentor
eligibility.quote: Not Allowed: Only accepting applications that do not propose clinical trials. Note: Applicants may propose to gain experience in a clinical trial led by a mentor/co-mentor

eligibility.item: Only New and Resubmission application types are allowed
eligibility.quote: Application Types Allowed New Resubmission

eligibility.item: Organizations may submit more than one application only if each is scientifically distinct and from a different candidate
eligibility.quote: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application, provided that each application is scientifically distinct, and each is from a different candidate.

eligibility.item: An individual may not have two or more competing NIH career development applications pending review concurrently
eligibility.quote: An individual may not have two or more competing NIH career development applications pending review concurrently.

eligibility.item: A new (A0) application is not accepted before the summary statement issues for an overlapping A0 or A1 application
eligibility.quote: A new (A0) application that is submitted before issuance of the summary statement from the review of an overlapping new (A0) or resubmission (A1) application.

eligibility.item: A resubmission (A1) is not accepted before the summary statement issues for the previous A0 application
eligibility.quote: A resubmission (A1) application that is submitted before issuance of the summary statement from the review of the previous new (A0) application.

eligibility.item: An application substantially overlapping another application pending appeal of initial peer review is not accepted
eligibility.quote: An application that has substantial overlap with another application pending appeal of initial peer review.

eligibility.item: All organizational registrations (SAM, UEI, eRA Commons, Grants.gov) must be completed before the application is submitted (allow 6 weeks or more)
eligibility.quote: All registrations must be completed prior to the application being submitted. Registration can take 6 weeks or more

eligibility.item: Maintain an active SAM registration, renewed at least annually
eligibility.quote: Applicants must complete and maintain an active registration, which requires renewal at least annually.

eligibility.item: Use the same UEI for all registrations and on the grant application
eligibility.quote: The same UEI must be used for all registrations, as well as on the grant application.

eligibility.item: Organization must register in eRA Commons with at least one Signing Official and one PD/PI account
eligibility.quote: Commons requires organizations to identify at least one Signing Official (SO) and at least one Program Director/Principal Investigator (PD/PI) account in order to submit an application.

eligibility.item: Organization must complete Grants.gov registration (requires active SAM registration)
eligibility.quote: Applicants must have an active SAM registration in order to complete the Grants.gov registration.

eligibility.item: All PD(s)/PI(s) must have an eRA Commons account affiliated with the applicant organization
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must have an eRA Commons account. PD(s)/PI(s) should work with their organizational officials to either create a new account or to affiliate their existing account

eligibility.item: A PD/PI who is also the organizational Signing Official must have two distinct eRA Commons accounts
eligibility.quote: If the PD/PI is also the organizational Signing Official, they must have two distinct eRA Commons accounts, one for each role.

eligibility.item: All PD(s)/PI(s) must enter their eRA Commons ID in the Credential field of the Senior/Key Person Profile form
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must include their eRA Commons ID in the Credential

eligibility.item: All PD(s)/PI(s) must be registered with ORCID and link the ORCID ID to their eRA Commons profile
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must be registered with ORCID

requiredDocuments.quote: Other Project Information All instructions in the SF424 (R&R) Application Guide must be followed.

requiredDocuments.item: SF424(R&R) Senior/Key Person Profile Expanded form
R&R Budget, with participant support in the Participant/Trainee Support Costs section
requiredDocuments.quote: Use the section on Participant/Trainee Support Costs to include all allowable categories of funds requested to support participants in the program.

requiredDocuments.item: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form
requiredDocuments.quote: The PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form is comprised of the following sections:

requiredDocuments.item: Plans and Statements of Mentor and Co-mentor(s), including the statement that the candidate will commit at least 6 person months (50%) effort
requiredDocuments.quote: The application must include a statement from the mentor providing: 1) information on their research qualifications and previous experience as a research supervisor;

requiredDocuments.item: Mentor/co-mentor statement documenting leadership of the clinical trial, if the candidate will gain clinical trial experience
requiredDocuments.quote: the mentor or co-mentor of the mentoring team must include a statement to document leadership of the clinical trial,

requiredDocuments.item: Signed Letters of Support from all collaborators and/or consultants describing their roles
requiredDocuments.quote: Signed statements must be provided by all collaborators and/or consultants confirming their participation in the project and describing their specific roles.

requiredDocuments.item: Signed statements from each advisory committee member (if applicable)
requiredDocuments.quote: Advisory committee members (if applicable): Signed statements must be provided by each member of the proposed advisory committee.

requiredDocuments.item: Institutional Commitment to the Candidate's Research Career Development statement from the sponsoring institution
requiredDocuments.quote: The sponsoring institution must provide a statement of commitment to the candidate's development into a productive, independent investigator and to meeting the requirements of this award.

requiredDocuments.item: At least one human subjects study record (or Delayed Onset Study record) on the PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information form if human subjects are involved
requiredDocuments.quote: you must include at least one human subjects study record using the Study Record: PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information form or Delayed Onset Study record.

requiredDocuments.item: Reference letters, submitted by referees through the eRA Commons Submit Referee Information link (applications lacking them are not reviewed)
requiredDocuments.quote: Applications lacking the appropriate required reference letters will not be reviewed.
